job: Enter a number and nudge it up or down.
purpose: A number input with steppers inside the field. Hold a stepper to repeat; steppers disable at min and max. Arrow keys and typing still work. fd:change fires with the new value.
useWhen: The value is a count or an amount with limits: retries, page depth, seats.
People change it by small steps more than they type it.

avoidWhen.when: The value sits on a scale and exact digits matter less than position.
The number has a unit that should show beside it.
The value is an ID, a phone number or a code of digits.
The code is sent to the person and entered once.

states.name: at limit
states.how: a stepper is disabled when the value reaches min or max

variants.useWhen: A short number; the width follows the input.

parts.role: The minus and plus buttons (data-fd-step="-1" or "1").

keyboard.does: Native: raise or lower the value by step.
On a stepper: changes the value; holding repeats.
